_comment: Hard-coded side classifications for essence-only / meta affixes whose side isn't reliably derivable from the base mod registry. Keyed by the essence row's `text` template (mirrors extra_mods.json essence entries). Add an entry whenever a poe2db essence row is calling a mod prefix/suffix and no base mod corroborates it.

_meta.source: Curated from poe2db essence pages and Path of Exile 2 wiki notes
_meta.abyss_kind: ABYSS = neither prefix nor suffix; the affix replaces an existing slot whose side is determined by side-fill or Crystallisation omens. Rendered as a full-width row in the essence panel.

#% of Physical Damage from Hits taken as.source: Perfect Essence of Ruin — display-text alias

Mark of the Abyssal Lord.source: Essence of the Abyss — placeholder, inherits replaced affix's side
